Class Stages

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.curriculum.Stages
public final class Stages extends Object
The default cumulative curriculum. Each stage keeps every head the previous one had and adds more, so nothing learned earlier is discarded.

    • SPAM

      private static final float SPAM
      What a swing made before the weapon is 60% back costs. Heavy on purpose: more than half of what a full hit is worth, so that a tap that lands is still a loss. (0.15 up to 0.12.1.)
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • FAR_AIM_SHARE

      private static final float FAR_AIM_SHARE
      How often the opponent is put far away, and how far: across a duel arena rather than a few steps off. Up to 0.13.3 every fight began within ten blocks and every aiming target was within eight, so an opponent twenty blocks away, which is where a fight on a server begins, was a few pixels the fighter had never seen: it lost the opponent, turned on the spot and looked at the floor.
